summary: The documents describe a system for handling email and template records within a HSPnet session, including functionalities for adding, updating, and deleting templates, as well as retrieving template information based on different criteria.
purpose: To manage email templates and related operations within a HSPnet session, including creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving templates.

fields.name: Template
fields.description: The main content of the template.

fields.name: TemplateAlt
fields.description: Alternative content of the template, used if an alternative language is required.

actors.name: HSPnetSession
actors.role: Facilitates database operations and session management.

workflows.name: Template Management
steps: Add a new template with name, template content, and alternative content.
Validate template information before creating or updating.
Update existing template information when an ID is provided.
Delete a template using its ID.

workflows.name: Template Retrieval
steps: Retrieve template by name using TemplateLookup.
Retrieve email template by emailJobID and name using EmailTemplateLookup.
Retrieve a list of templates containing specified text.

business_rules: Template or TemplateAlt must be specified.

validations.rule: Template and TemplateAlt must not be blank.

system_behavior: The system retrieves data from the database using stored procedures.
Template data is refreshed by querying the database with specified keywords.

exceptions.handling: Return error messages and halt operation.
